name: HYDRA Densification
aliases: HYDRA: Hybrid Decomposition for Rendering-Aware Preservation
definition: A densification strategy that decomposes complex primitives into simpler constituents within the MCMC framework, enabling generalizable planar primitives to operate within MCMC.
summary: HYDRA Densification is a 3D Gaussian Splatting strategy that decomposes complex primitives using a learned MLP to preserve distributions, distinguishing itself from standard splitting by handling multi-lobed boundaries within an MCMC framework.
